videos.title: Tiger Shroff’s Singing Skills

videos.title: Ramayan’s 33 Years, Cast Celebrates
videos.overview: The cast of late Ramanand Sagar’s iconic serial Ramayana reunites to celebrate the 33 years of its airing. Kapil Sharma invites Arun Govil (Ram), Dipika (Sita) and Sunil Lahri (Lakman) with huge applause from the audience. Kapil goes nostalgic as he shares his first meeting with Arun Govil. Meanwhile, Arun reveals that his first audition was rejected by Sagar for the role of Shri Ram. Dipika and Sunil also share about how they were finalized to play their roles. Further, Arun narrates how he was abused by a man for smoking a cigarette, as they considered him God. Dipika shares how she realized after two-three months of Ramayan airing, that she and Arun were being revered by senior citizens too. Kiku Sharda and Bharti Singh’s humorous act leaves the cast in splits. Later, Prem Sagar, son of Ramanand Sagar arrives and launches the biography of his visionary father titled ‘An Epic Life: Ramanand Sagar, From Barsaat to Ramayan’ written by him.
